name: cAMP responsive element binding protein 3 like 2
pathways: regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: CREB3L2 encodes cyclic AMP-responsive element-binding protein 3-like protein 2 [Cleaved into: Processed cyclic AMP-responsive element-binding protein 3-like protein 2]. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

function.text: CREB3L2 encodes cyclic AMP-responsive element-binding protein 3-like protein 2. Based in part on similarity, it is a transcription factor involved in unfolded protein response (UPR). The released N-terminal cytosolic domain is translocated to the nucleus to effect transcription of specific target genes. It contributes to chondrogenesis by activating the transcription of SEC23A, which promotes the transport and secretion of cartilage matrix proteins, and possibly that of ER biogenesis-related genes.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CREB3L2 have been reported in low-grade fibromyxoid sarcoma and sclerosing epithelioid fibrosarcoma.
